Most submissive [Cobweb](../persons.html#675),
The only change that I would suggest this time would be that for the word Evangelists you should substitute Gospels – as the Forms to which you refer rather symbolize the characteristics of the Gospels themselves than of their writers The [answers](../others.html#104) will carry you all very deep and high.
[The Humble Bee](../persons.html#81)[^2] will be delighted with [Kepler](../persons.html#1850) as the stars are her peculiar line.

We shall have such beautiful stories of [Handel](../persons.html#1851) that I much look forward to him, but I wonder if any one will take the new view of [Wallace](../persons.html#1852)?
your faithful
Mother Goose

[^1]: Tiny 95mm x 54mm blue envelope addressed to ‘Miss Helmore/6 Cheyne Walk/Chelsea/SW’ postmarked Winchester 18 March 1861 and London 19 March 1861,

[^2]: (Frances) Emily Moberly (1844-1921) was a Gosling as Humble Bee from 1859-1868(?),
